name: {{code}}_ingest_review
description: Canonical ingest of a returned SME review workbook: parses the sample sheet (repairing a damaged header row by position — it happens), normalises ratings, tallies the reviewer's own error categories, and emits both the reviewed rows and an eval-shaped terms set (reference = her correction where given, else the text she rated). SET xlsx_path to the returned file before running. Each round is ingested exactly once, by a tracked run — never re-parsed ad hoc. Promotes {{code}}_round_sample + {{code}}_round_terms.
